scripts.build: pnpm -r run typecheck && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.package: git diff --quiet HEAD && mkdir -p release && git archive --format=zip --prefix=ifcui/ -o release/ifcui-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD).zip HEAD && echo release/ifcui-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD).zip || (echo 'Commit or stash your changes first: the package is built from HEAD.' && exit 1)
